site.description: Brett Whitson is an Oracle DBA and Ellucian Banner systems administrator at the University of Tennessee at Martin, with a background in software development.
site.jobTitle: Oracle DBA and Banner Systems Administrator

sections.title: About
sections.body: I'm an Oracle DBA and Banner systems administrator at the University of Tennessee at Martin, where I've spent the last five years keeping the university's Ellucian Banner ERP running, first as a programmer/analyst writing PL/SQL and integrations, and now administering the databases underneath it. I have a B.S. in Computer Science, and outside the database I still love front-end work: this site is hand-built with vanilla JavaScript and SCSS.

roles.title: IT Administrator IV - Oracle DBA and Banner Systems Administrator
bullets: Administer the Oracle databases behind the university's Ellucian Banner ERP: installation, configuration, patching, backup and recovery, and user access management.
Plan and apply Banner and Oracle upgrades and patch sets, coordinating testing and downtime with campus stakeholders and Ellucian support.
Monitor and tune database performance, and automate routine administration with SQL, PL/SQL, and shell scripting on Linux.

roles.title: Programmer/Analyst
bullets: Designed, built, and maintained software supporting university operations on the Ellucian Banner ERP system.
Wrote and optimized SQL queries, PL/SQL packages, and stored procedures for complex data operations, with a focus on data integrity and performance.
Maintained and extended Banner modules, including custom integrations with third-party applications and APIs.
Gathered requirements with stakeholders across departments and delivered solutions that improved efficiency for staff and students.

roles.title: IT Technician III
bullets: Resolved escalated hardware, software, and local network issues from the student help desk, and helped run the ticket queue and equipment inventory.

roles.title: Student Technician - IT Help Desk, Field Services, Config/Install
bullets: Deployed PC and Mac workstations for faculty and staff, provided in-person and phone support, and trained new student workers.

roles.title: Part-time App/Web Developer
bullets: Built front-end components from provided designs, and developed, tested, and documented back-end functionality.

body.subheader: Fall 2019 - First Place, Undergraduate Presentations, ACM Mid-Southeast Conference
body.main: Built with two teammates: a web application for managing virtualized services (Docker containers) from the browser.
Built with two teammates: a desktop interface for managing local Docker containers.
A DFS algorithm that decides whether a graph is bipartite, implemented in four paradigms: procedural, object-oriented, functional, and logic.
Team-built theremin-like instrument using ultrasonic sensors on a Raspberry Pi, with sound from Sonic Pi.
Pair-programmed application for tracking spending and building budget plans.
Oracle Database administration, Ellucian Banner ERP, PL/SQL development, performance tuning, backup and recovery, Linux server management, networking fundamentals

sections.title: Interests
sections.body: Outside of work I play guitar, play video games, travel, and study new languages.
